method: Questions were researched with an evidence-only retrieval tool over one corpus of open-access and public-domain texts (see corpus.json). Each excerpt was checked word for word against the corpus passage it cites when this file was written; corpus_chunk numbers that passage in the corpus snapshot of 2026-10-01.
questions: How do philosophers define critical thinking, and how does it relate to epistemology?
Who coined the word epistemology? Ferrier's Institutes of Metaphysic and the divisions epistemology agnoiology ontology
When is testimony a good reason to believe? Reductionism and anti-reductionism about testimonial justification
Are anecdotes evidence? A single case as weak evidence, likelihood ratio and incremental confirmation
Should the strength of our assent match the strength of the evidence? Degrees of assent and the ethics of proportioning belief
